parameters.query: INSERT INTO customers (external_id, name, email, channel, first_interaction_at, last_interaction_at, metadata) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now(), now(), $5::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (external_id, channel) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, email = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.email, ''), customers.email), last_interaction_at = now(), updated_at = now() RETURNING id, external_id, name, email, channel, first_interaction_at, last_interaction_at, metadata::text;
